name: set_front_page
description: Set a published page as the site's static front page (homepage). Recorded as an undoable batch. Pass dry_run=true to preview without changing anything.

dry_run.description: Preview only; nothing is changed

name: set_custom_css
description: Add site-wide CSS inside one marked block of WordPress Additional CSS. The owner's own CSS outside the block is never touched. Replaces the block on each call. Undoable. dry_run=true previews.

css.description: Plain CSS to apply site-wide (no HTML tags)

dry_run.description: Preview only; nothing is changed

name: set_primary_menu
description: Build the primary menu ("Main Menu") from up to 30 items (a published page_id or a url each) and assign it to the theme's menu location. Replaces that menu's items. Undoable. dry_run=true previews.

items.description: Ordered menu items; page_id wins when both page_id and url are given

dry_run.description: Preview only; nothing is changed

name: publish_page
description: Publish a draft or pending page now, or schedule it with publish_at (ISO 8601 with a timezone, in the future). Does not change the page content. Undoable. dry_run=true previews.

page_id.description: ID of a draft or pending page

publish_at.description: Optional. Schedule instead of publishing now, e.g. 2026-12-01T09:00:00+01:00

dry_run.description: Preview only; nothing is changed

name: propose_php_snippet
description: Propose a PHP snippet (post type, hook, shortcode...) for the site owner to REVIEW. It is stored inert on the Pro tab and is never run or saved to the site. Say what it does and where to put it.

description.description: What it does and where or how to apply it

name: list_batches
description: List recent Pro changes (batches), newest first: what each changed and whether it can still be undone with undo_batch. Administrators see all; other users see their own.

name: undo_batch
description: Undo one batch from list_batches. Restores every item it safely can and reports the rest; an item changed since is skipped unless force=true. Claims "fully undone" only if all items restored. dry_run=true previews.

force.description: Restore items even if they changed since (never invents a missing undo point)

dry_run.description: Preview only; nothing is changed

name: list_theme_layouts
description: List the live Divi Theme Builder templates and their header, footer and body layouts (read-only). With layout_id of a header, footer or body, also returns its content. Edit one with update_theme_layout or edit_theme_layout (dry_run first: it shows on every page that uses the template).

layout_id.description: Optional. A header, footer or body layout id from this list; adds its content to the answer

name: update_theme_layout
description: Replace the content of a live Divi header, footer or body (layout_id from list_theme_layouts) with a new Divi 5 layout. Rejected with the exact violations unless it passes every check. It shows on every page that uses the template: use dry_run=true first. Undoable.

layout_id.description: A header, footer or body layout id from list_theme_layouts

content.description: The full Divi 5 layout (block markup) for this layout

dry_run.description: Preview only; nothing is changed

name: edit_theme_layout
description: Find and replace literal text inside a live Divi header, footer or body (layout_id from list_theme_layouts), leaving the rest untouched. The result must pass every layout check. It shows on every page that uses the template: use dry_run=true first. Undoable.

layout_id.description: A header, footer or body layout id from list_theme_layouts

find.description: Exact text to find (must match one place, unless expect_count says otherwise)

replace.description: Text to put in its place (may be empty)

expect_count.description: Optional. Replace all of exactly this many matches

dry_run.description: Preview only; nothing is changed

name: manage_theme_template
description: Enable or disable one live Divi Theme Builder template, or change where it applies (assign: use_on / exclude_from, in the ids list_theme_layouts shows). Affects the whole site: call with dry_run=true first, then repeat with the token it returns. Undoable. Cannot create or delete templates.

use_on.description: assign only: where the template applies (replaces the current list)

exclude_from.description: assign only: where it must not apply (replaces the current list)

dry_run.description: Preview only; returns the token a real run needs

token.description: The token from your dry run of the same arguments; it works once, within 30 minutes

name: find_replace_site
description: Replace literal text across Divi 5 pages (and, with Theme Builder permission, the live header and footer) as one undoable batch. Always call with dry_run=true first, then repeat with the token it returns. Items that would fail the layout checks are skipped. At most 50 items per run.

find.description: Exact text to find (case-sensitive, literal, not a pattern)

replace.description: Text to put in its place (may be empty)

page_ids.description: Optional. Only these page or layout ids

dry_run.description: Preview only; returns the token a real run needs

token.description: The token from your dry run of the same arguments; it works once, within 30 minutes

name: audit_site
description: Read-only audit of Divi 5 pages and the live header/footer: layout check violations, unknown preset, color, variable or custom-field ids, and internal links to missing or unpublished pages. 25 items per call in id order; pass next_cursor to continue. Makes no remote request.

cursor.description: Where to continue: the next_cursor of the previous call, the id of the last item audited (default 0 = from the start)

name: build_site
description: Build a whole Divi 5 site as one undoable build. add_page creates one checked DRAFT page per call (an invalid page or a taken slug is refused, the build continues); status lists it; launch publishes it (dry_run first, then repeat with the token). Undo it all: undo_batch.

title.description: add_page: the page title (plain text); not with brief

slug.description: add_page: the page slug; it must not be used by another page

content.description: add_page: the Divi 5 layout (it must pass every check), or pass brief instead

brief.description: add_page: a Divi 5 Lab brief instead of content (the same brief lab_build takes); its title is the page title. Later brief pages may leave out language and kit: they take the build's look

menu_label.description: add_page: the menu label (default: the title), at most 100 bytes

in_menu.description: add_page: put the page in the primary menu at launch (default true if you may edit menus, else false)

is_front.description: add_page: make this the front page at launch (one page per build)

build_id.description: The build to use: returned by the first add_page; required for later pages and for launch

dry_run.description: launch: preview only; returns the token a real launch needs

token.description: launch: the token from your dry run of the same build; it works once, within 30 minutes

name: manage_global_colors
description: Create, recolor, rename or deactivate the site's Divi global colors (never deletes). The five theme colors need allow_theme_colors=true. Affects every page using a color: call with dry_run=true first, then repeat with the preview_token. Undoable.

colors.description: The changes. No id = create a color (label and color needed). With an id (from list_global_styles) = change that color: any of label, color, status.

id.description: gcid-... of an existing color; leave out to create one

color.description: Hex (#rgb, #rgba, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa) or rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() with plain numbers

status.description: inactive retires a color without deleting it

dry_run.description: Preview only; returns the preview_token a real run needs

preview_token.description: The token from your dry run of the same arguments; it works once, within 30 minutes

allow_theme_colors.description: Needed to change one of the five theme colors (primary, secondary, heading, body, link): that restyles the whole theme

name: manage_global_variables
description: Create, edit or archive the site's Divi global variables of type numbers (12px, clamp()) and strings (never deletes). Affects every page using a variable: call with dry_run=true first, then repeat with the preview_token. Undoable.

variables.description: The changes. No id = create a variable (type, label and value needed). With an id (from list_global_styles) = change that numbers or strings variable: any of label, value, status.

id.description: gvid-... of an existing variable; leave out to create one

type.description: Needed to create; never changes afterwards

value.description: numbers: a number with an optional unit or calc()/clamp()/min()/max() of those. strings: plain text up to 200 characters (balanced brackets, no braces, semicolons, quotes, comment markers or code)

status.description: archived retires a variable without deleting it

dry_run.description: Preview only; returns the preview_token a real run needs

preview_token.description: The token from your dry run of the same arguments; it works once, within 30 minutes

name: manage_global_presets
description: Create or update the site's Divi module presets (never deletes). Pages use one with modulePreset ["<id>"], so a change restyles every module citing it. Call with dry_run=true first, then repeat with the preview_token. Undoable.

presets.description: The changes. No id = create a preset (module, name and attrs needed). With an id (from list_global_styles) = change that preset: name and/or attrs (attrs REPLACES its whole style tree).

id.description: Id of an existing preset; leave out to create one

module.description: Needed to create, e.g. divi/heading; never changes afterwards

attrs.description: The style attributes, in the same shape a layout block uses (for example title.decoration.font.font.desktop.value.size). No custom CSS or code.

dry_run.description: Preview only; returns the preview_token a real run needs

preview_token.description: The token from your dry run of the same arguments; it works once, within 30 minutes

allow_default_presets.description: Needed to change a module's DEFAULT preset: that restyles every module of that type without a preset of its own

name: set_custom_fields
description: Set custom field values on ONE page, Divi Project or other post you can edit. Only keys the site knows; never protected or secret keys, code, or ACF lists and images. All or nothing; one undoable batch. dry_run previews. Read fields first with get_custom_fields.

fields.description: Up to 25 fields to set, each with a key and a text value

dry_run.description: Preview only; nothing is changed

name: create_product
description: Create up to 25 new simple WooCommerce products as DRAFTS (never published). Sets name, texts, SKU, prices, stock, existing categories, tags and Media Library images. All or nothing; one undoable batch. dry_run previews. If list_products is available, use it first to see the catalogue.

name.description: Product name (plain text, at most 200 characters)

stock_status.description: instock, outofstock or onbackorder (only when manage_stock is false)

backorders.description: no, notify or yes (only when manage_stock is true)

dimensions.description: length, width and height as decimal strings

virtual.description: A product that is not shipped

sold_individually.description: Limit purchases to one per order

dry_run.description: Preview only; nothing is created

name: update_products
description: Change existing WooCommerce products: prices and sale dates, stock, texts, SKU, categories, tags, images, size and variation rows. Never publishes, creates or deletes. Call with dry_run=true first, then repeat with its token. One undoable batch. Read current values with get_product first.

updates.description: The products to change (1 to 25); omit a field to leave it alone

id.description: The variation id (it must belong to this product)

sale_price.description: Decimal string lower than regular_price, or "" to clear

stock_status.description: instock, outofstock or onbackorder (only when stock is not managed)

backorders.description: no, notify or yes (only when stock is managed)

name.description: Product name (plain text, at most 200 characters)

description.description: Long description (HTML allowed, no scripts), or "" to clear

short_description.description: Short description (HTML allowed, no scripts), or "" to clear

categories.description: Existing category slugs; the list replaces the current categories

tags.description: Existing tag slugs; the list replaces the current tags

image_id.description: Media Library image id, or 0 to remove the image

gallery_image_ids.description: Media Library image ids; the list replaces the gallery

dimensions.description: length, width and height as decimal strings; only the axes given change

variations.description: Variable products only: up to 100 variation rows to change

id.description: The variation id (it must belong to this product)

sale_price.description: Decimal string lower than regular_price, or "" to clear

stock_status.description: instock, outofstock or onbackorder (only when stock is not managed)

backorders.description: no, notify or yes (only when stock is managed)

dry_run.description: Preview only; returns the token a real run needs

token.description: The token from your dry run of the same arguments; it works once, within 30 minutes

name: bulk_adjust_prices
description: Raise or lower the REGULAR prices of the WooCommerce products a filter matches, by a percent or an amount, rounded exactly. Never touches sale prices or anything else. Call with dry_run=true first, then repeat with its token. Unadjustable products are skipped with a reason. One undoable batch.

filter.description: Which products. Give at least one of categories, tags, types, stock_status, on_sale, search, ids - or all=true. Only published products unless status says otherwise.

on_sale.description: Only products on sale now (true) or not (false)

search.description: A phrase contained in the product name (case-insensitive)

all.description: true = every product (in the allowed statuses); cannot be combined with the narrowing filters

change.description: mode "percent" (-90 to 500) or "amount", value a signed decimal STRING, for example {"mode":"percent","value":"-10"}

round_to.description: Optional: what new prices should end in, for example "0.95" or "0.5"; "0" for whole numbers. Without it prices are rounded to the shop's decimals.

dry_run.description: Preview only; returns the token a real run needs

token.description: The token from your dry run of the same arguments; it works once, within 30 minutes

name: switch_design
description: Restyle Divi 5 pages built with this plugin to another design language and/or style kit, deterministically. It switches colours, fonts, headline type, section spacing and kit-styled modules. Always dry_run=true first, then repeat with the token. Undoable.

page_id.description: One page or Divi Project id (or use page_ids)

page_ids.description: Up to 25 page or Project ids, switched as one batch (or use page_id)

to_language.description: Target design language id (get_style_guide topic design-languages); omitted keeps the page's own

to_kit.description: Target style kit id, or "default" for the target language's own kit; omitted keeps the page's own

from_language.description: Optional. The language the page was built with (detected otherwise)

from_kit.description: Optional. The kit the page was built with (detected otherwise)

mode.description: leave (default): only blocks that exactly match a kit style switch; conform: near matches are re-styled too

dry_run.description: Preview only; returns the report and the token a real run needs

token.description: The token from your dry run of the same arguments; it works once, within 30 minutes

name: manage_mega_menu
description: Make the global header's menu a mega menu built from Divi modules. status (read-only) lists 14 layouts and menu items; apply sets a layout (item_id: one item); update rebuilds from the menu; remove restores it. Checked, undoable with undo_batch; dry_run previews. Needs the Theme Builder permission.

item_id.description: apply only: the menu item id to give this layout (a mega menu must already be applied)

edited.description: When a panel was changed in the Divi builder: keep your changes or rebuild it. Without it a real run stops and asks.

dry_run.description: Preview only; nothing is changed

name: lab_restyle
description: Rebuild pages made with Divi 5 Lab in another design language and/or style kit, exactly as Lab would build them now. Only unedited Lab pages; edited ones are skipped (use switch_design). Always dry_run=true first, then repeat with the token. Undoable.

page_id.description: One Lab page id (or use page_ids or all_mine)

page_ids.description: Up to 25 Lab page ids, restyled as one batch (or use page_id or all_mine)

all_mine.description: true: every page you built with Lab (at most 25; use page_ids when you have more)

to_language.description: Target design language id (get_style_guide topic design-languages); omitted keeps each page's own

to_kit.description: Target style kit id, or "default" for the language's own kit; omitted keeps each page's own

include_published.description: Also restyle Lab pages that are already published (default false: only drafts)

dry_run.description: Preview only; returns the report and the token a real run needs

token.description: The token from your dry run of the same arguments; it works once, within 30 minutes
